name: 1 Apr 1958

references.label: Newtownabbey Urban District Act (Northern Ireland) 1957
references.note: Private Act constituting Belfast Rural District, with altered boundaries, as Newtownabbey Urban District and transferring the rest of Belfast RD to Antrim, Lisburn and Larne RDs (objects of the Bill as published in Belfast Gazette issue 1848, 23 Nov 1956, pages 311-312). Royal Assent notified in Belfast Gazette issue 1884, 2 Aug 1957, page 211. Belfast Rural District was abolished and Newtownabbey Urban District formed on 1 Apr 1958: the Newtownabbey Urban District (Electoral Areas) Order (Northern Ireland) 1957 (S.R. & O. 1957 No. 222, https://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisro/1957/222/contents/made) recites that date from the Act, and the Census of Population 1961, General Report (HMSO Belfast), pp. xvi-xvii, changes in administrative areas during the intercensal period, https://www.nisra.gov.uk/publications/1961-census-reports, gives the same day.

references.label: Census of Population 1961: County Antrim
references.note: Changes 1951-61: Larne RD to Larne MB 1 Apr 1956; Belfast RD abolished 1 Apr 1958 (Newtownabbey UD; rest to Antrim, Larne and Lisburn RDs). Areas: Larne MB 2,521 ac 2 r 18 p; Newtownabbey UD 6,006 ac 1 r 12 p; Ballyduff DED (Antrim RD) 4,112 ac; Ballygomartin DED (Lisburn RD) 10,558 ac.

references.label: Newtownabbey Urban District (Electoral Areas) Order (Northern Ireland) 1957 (S.R. & O. 1957 No. 222)
references.note: Seven wards of Newtownabbey UD; Ballyduff DED (Antrim RD), Ballygomartin DED (Lisburn RD) and an addition to Carrickfergus Rural DED (Larne RD) formed from the transferred areas.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1889, 6 September 1957, pp. 243-244
references.note: S.R.&O. 1957 No. 189 (County Borough of Belfast) and No. 188 (County Down): Orders in Council under section 11 of the Boundary Survey (Ireland) Act 1854, made 29 Aug 1957, in force 1 Mar 1958, extending Belfast at Sydenham into Belfast Lough.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1965, 20 February 1959, p. 66
references.note: Notice of Orders in Council under section 11 of the Boundary Survey (Ireland) Act 1854 (Armagh, Down and the County Borough of Belfast), in force 1 Apr 1959; the Belfast order is dated 9 Feb 1959.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 1979, 29 May 1959, p. 185
references.note: The Belfast Boundary Survey order of 9 Feb 1959 (in force 1 Apr 1959).

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 2070, 24 February 1961, p. 58
references.note: The area added to Belfast by the 1959 order "consists of reclaimed lands at Sydenham".

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1961: County Borough of Belfast
references.note: Area 18,052 acres including 2,237 acres of tidal water; the land 458 acres more than in 1951, all in Victoria Ward, from the reclamation of land from Belfast Lough. 1951: 15,357 acres of land and 1,223 acres of tidal water.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Armagh urban district boundary are traced from the map deposited with the 1946 Order (about 20 m); parts of the Lurgan borough boundary are traced from the 1956 Order's plan (about 25 m); parts of the Bangor borough boundary are taken from the council's 1965 map of the existing boundary, registered on the OSNI six-inch Edition 5 sheets (about 20 m), and short stretches from the extension plan (about 25 m); parts of the Larne borough boundary are traced from the 1956 extension map (about 25 m); Newtownabbey's inland line follows whole townlands read from a small-scale scheme map and is not confirmed. They are drawn dotted on the map.
